description: Two Iowa Republican politicians running for reelection this November made a stop at a family-owned dairy farm to talk with local producers. Iowa Secretary of Agriculture Mike Naig and Attorney General Brenna Bird were given a tour of Cornbelt Dairy located in Cherokee County.
